faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains is 100 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $1.35/pc (100 pcs starter tier), $0.78/pc (500 pcs tier), and $0.52/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains is $60 Film/Etch (Waived @ 500+). Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains?
faqs.answer: Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains is custom-engineered from 1.5mm Brass / Iron using Fine-Line Acid Photo-Etching + Enamel + Clear Epoxy, sized around 45×25×1.8mm at approximately 20g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Shiny Gold / Silver / Antique Brass. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What backings, attachments, and accessories come with Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains?
faqs.answer: This custom format ships with 28mm Split Ring + Jump Ring. Upgrade hardware options such as deluxe locking pin clutches, magnetic no-hole bar clasps, custom split rings, or velvet presentation boxes can be specified in your quote.

faqs.question: Can we get a free digital artwork proof before paying for tooling or samples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.question: Can we order a physical pre-production sample of Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains before mass production?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains completes in 8–11 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains?
faqs.answer: Beyond complimentary individual polybags, Custom Photo-Etched Brass Enamel Keychains can be packaged onto custom printed 350gsm retail backing cards, sealed inside clear acrylic coin capsules, or presented in flocked velvet gift boxes.
